description:
Implement fluid typography that scales based on screen width using CSS clamp() or equivalent. Create mobile-specific font sizes that improve readability without horizontal scrolling.

**Rationale:** Small screens require larger text and tighter line heights. Dynamic scaling ensures comfortable reading across all device sizes while maintaining visual hierarchy.
title: Responsive Typography Scale
